done_when: When replaying a stacked part or follow-up fix onto the default branch conflicts, close names forge work <item> to merge the default branch, then forge close <item>, and names no rebase or force push

known.title: Gate: Update the shipped replay-conflict recovery guidance

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - a coordinator follows the shipped skill after a follow-up replay conflict.
The refusal now prescribes merge recovery, but src/forge/templates/skill.md:1694-1695 still says close “stops with a replay command” and instructs agents to follow “replay and leased publication commands” before closing again. Those are the recovery steps this patch removes. The coordinator's conditional requirement to update guides describing the old recovery therefore applies. Update this paragraph to prescribe forge work followed by forge close so client repositories receive consistent recovery instructions.
findings.title: Gate: Update the shipped replay-conflict recovery guidance

stop.reason: Owner chose one more round: fix the shipped guide lines so they match the merge step

why: Close's replay-conflict refusal tells the agent to rebase and force-push, but Forge's own hook blocks that push, so a person must use a terminal (Forge issue 1292). Merging the default branch into the branch already works: close skips the replay when origin/<default> is an ancestor of HEAD.
